upright.zh: 一段全新的旅程即将展开，放下顾虑，带着好奇心迈出第一步。
upright.en: A brand new journey is opening up — set your worries aside and take the first step with curiosity.

reversed.zh: 冲动行事或对未知的恐惧正让你裹足不前，出发前不妨再想清楚一点。
reversed.en: Impulsiveness or fear of the unknown is holding you back; think things through before you leap.

upright.zh: 你已具备实现目标所需的一切工具，是时候主动出击、把想法变成现实。
upright.en: You already have every tool you need — it's time to act and turn intention into reality.

reversed.zh: 才华或资源没有被善用，或是有人在操纵局面，需要重新审视自己的动机。
reversed.en: Talent or resources are being misused, or someone is manipulating the situation — check your motives.

upright.zh: 答案已经在你心里，静下心来倾听直觉，而不是急着向外寻求。
upright.en: The answer is already within you — get quiet and listen to your intuition instead of searching outward.

reversed.zh: 你可能在压抑真实的感受，或是有些事情被刻意隐瞒，真相尚未浮出水面。
reversed.en: You may be suppressing your true feelings, or something is being deliberately hidden from you.

upright.zh: 生活正在多个层面开花结果，允许自己享受这份丰盛并悉心滋养身边的人事物。
upright.en: Life is blossoming on several fronts — let yourself enjoy this abundance and nurture what's around you.

reversed.zh: 创造力或人际关系出现停滞，也可能是过度付出而忽略了照顾自己。
reversed.en: Creativity or relationships have stalled, or you've been giving so much you forgot to care for yourself.

upright.zh: 建立清晰的规则与结构，用稳定的领导力把混乱局面收拾妥当。
upright.en: Set clear rules and structure — steady leadership will bring an unruly situation back under control.

reversed.zh: 过度控制或固执己见正在造成压力，也可能是权威或秩序正在瓦解。
reversed.en: Excessive control or stubbornness is creating strain, or an authority/structure is starting to crumble.

upright.zh: 遵循经过检验的方法或寻求一位导师的建议，会让你少走弯路。
upright.en: Following a tested method or a mentor's advice will save you from unnecessary detours.

reversed.zh: 是时候质疑传统规则，走出一条属于自己的路，而不是盲从既定框架。
reversed.en: It's time to question convention and carve your own path instead of blindly following the rules.

upright.zh: 一份重要的关系或抉择摆在眼前，跟随内心真正认同的价值去做出选择。
upright.en: An important relationship or choice is in front of you — decide according to what you truly value.

reversed.zh: 关系中出现分歧或不平衡，一个艰难的选择正在考验你的价值观。
reversed.en: There's friction or imbalance in a relationship, and a hard choice is testing your values.

upright.zh: 凭借坚定的意志和明确的方向，你能克服阻力、掌控局面并取得进展。
upright.en: With firm will and a clear direction, you can push through resistance and take charge.

reversed.zh: 内心的矛盾或外部的阻碍让你偏离了方向，需要重新找回专注与自律。
reversed.en: Inner conflict or outside obstacles have pulled you off course — refocus and find your discipline again.

upright.zh: 真正的力量来自温柔而坚定的耐心，用柔软化解困难比硬碰硬更有效。
upright.en: Real strength comes from gentle, steady patience — softness resolves more than force ever could.

reversed.zh: 自我怀疑或情绪失控正在消耗你的力量，先安顿好自己的内心。
reversed.en: Self-doubt or an emotional flare-up is draining your strength — settle your own heart first.

upright.zh: 暂时退后一步、独自沉淀，答案会在安静的反思中慢慢清晰。
upright.en: Step back and sit with yourself for a while — the answer will surface in quiet reflection.

reversed.zh: 过度的孤立让你与外界脱节，或是你在逃避该面对的问题。
reversed.en: Too much isolation has cut you off from others, or you're avoiding something you need to face.

upright.zh: 命运的齿轮正在转动，一个新的周期或意外的机遇即将到来，顺势而为。
upright.en: The wheel is turning — a new cycle or unexpected opportunity is arriving, so move with it.

reversed.zh: 变化带来的不是你期待的方向，或是你正在抗拒本该发生的转变。
reversed.en: Change isn't going the way you hoped, or you're resisting a shift that needs to happen.

upright.zh: 以公正、诚实的态度面对当下的局面，过去的行为终将得到相应的结果。
upright.en: Face the situation honestly and fairly — past actions are about to catch up with their consequences.

reversed.zh: 不公平的对待或是你在逃避应负的责任，真相仍需进一步厘清。
reversed.en: You're facing unfair treatment, or avoiding a responsibility that's yours — the truth still needs sorting out.

upright.zh: 主动放慢脚步、换个视角看问题，牺牲眼前的执着能带来新的领悟。
upright.en: Slow down on purpose and look from a new angle — letting go of what you're gripping brings insight.

reversed.zh: 无谓的拖延或牺牲让你原地打转，是时候结束这种被动等待了。
reversed.en: Needless delay or sacrifice has you spinning in place — it's time to stop this passive waiting.

upright.zh: 一个阶段正在结束，唯有放手让旧的过去，新的可能才能真正开始。
upright.en: A chapter is ending — only by letting the old go can something new truly begin.

reversed.zh: 你正在抗拒一个必要的结束，迟迟不肯放手反而让自己更痛苦。
reversed.en: You're resisting an ending that needs to happen; refusing to let go is only prolonging the pain.

upright.zh: 以耐心和中庸之道调和对立的两端，稳步前行会比走极端更长久。
upright.en: Blend opposites with patience and moderation — steady progress will outlast any extreme.

reversed.zh: 生活中的某些方面正走向极端或失衡，需要重新找回节奏与分寸。
reversed.en: Some part of your life is tipping into excess or imbalance — find your rhythm and proportion again.

upright.zh: 留意让你上瘾或困住你的执念，它可能以诱惑或恐惧的形式悄悄控制你。
upright.en: Notice what's got a hold on you — it may be controlling you quietly through temptation or fear.

reversed.zh: 你正开始意识到那些束缚，并有勇气挣脱不健康的关系或习惯。
reversed.en: You're starting to see those chains clearly, and finding the courage to break an unhealthy pattern.

upright.zh: 一场突如其来的变故打破了原本的假象，废墟之上才能建立更真实的基础。
upright.en: A sudden upheaval has shattered the illusion — something truer can be built on the rubble.

reversed.zh: 你在竭力回避一场迟早会到来的崩塌，或正从上一次的震荡中慢慢恢复。
reversed.en: You're working hard to avoid a collapse that's coming anyway, or slowly recovering from the last one.

upright.zh: 风暴过后，希望重新降临，保持信心，疗愈与灵感正在悄然回归。
upright.en: After the storm, hope returns — stay confident, healing and inspiration are quietly on their way back.

reversed.zh: 你对未来感到灰心失望，或是暂时失去了继续前行的信心。
reversed.en: You feel discouraged about the future, or have temporarily lost the confidence to keep going.

upright.zh: 眼前的局面并不完全清晰，留意潜意识和梦境透露出的线索，谨慎前行。
upright.en: Things aren't fully clear yet — pay attention to what your subconscious and dreams reveal, and tread carefully.

reversed.zh: 笼罩已久的迷雾正在散去，真相逐渐浮现，但仍需警惕残留的困惑与误解。
reversed.en: A long-standing fog is finally lifting and the truth is emerging, though some confusion still lingers.

upright.zh: 喜悦、成功与活力正照耀着你，尽情享受这份明朗与真实的自信。
upright.en: Joy, success, and vitality are shining on you — enjoy this clarity and well-earned confidence.

reversed.zh: 本该有的喜悦被暂时遮蔽，或是盲目乐观让你忽略了一些细节。
reversed.en: The joy you deserve is temporarily overshadowed, or blind optimism is making you miss some details.

upright.zh: 一次重要的觉醒或转折召唤着你，认真回顾过去，勇敢迎接新的篇章。
upright.en: An important awakening is calling you — look back honestly and step bravely into a new chapter.

reversed.zh: 过度的自我批判或对改变的犹豫，让你难以回应内心真正的召唤。
reversed.en: Excessive self-criticism or hesitation about change is keeping you from answering a real calling.

upright.zh: 一个重要的旅程或阶段圆满完成，尽情庆祝这份来之不易的成就与完整。
upright.en: An important journey has reached fulfillment — celebrate this hard-won sense of wholeness.

reversed.zh: 还有一些事情尚未收尾，完成的时刻被延迟，或是你难以真正感到满足。
reversed.en: Something is still unfinished, completion is delayed, or true satisfaction is hard to feel right now.

upright.zh: 一份全新的行动与热情正蓬勃萌发，全心投入这份初生的干劲。
upright.en: A brand new spark of action and passion is emerging — throw yourself into this early drive.

reversed.zh: 这份行动与热情的萌芽被压抑，停滞的热情让你迟迟无法真正开始。
reversed.en: This spark of action and passion is being held back, and stalled drive keeps you from truly starting.

upright.zh: 你正面临一个关于事业或创作的选择或需要找到平衡的伙伴关系。
upright.en: You're facing a choice about your career or creative work, or need to find balance with a partner.

reversed.zh: 选择陷入僵局，或事业或创作中的平衡被打破。
reversed.en: A choice has stalled, or the balance around your career or creative work has been thrown off.

upright.zh: 初步的努力开始显现成果，事业或创作正稳步向前扩展。
upright.en: Early effort is starting to pay off — your career or creative work is steadily expanding.

reversed.zh: 扩展的计划遇到延迟，团队或计划中出现协作上的落差。
reversed.en: An expanding plan hits a delay, or a team effort loses coordination.

upright.zh: 是时候稳固已有的成果，在事业或创作中找到一个安稳的立足点。
upright.en: It's time to secure what you've built and find stable footing in your career or creative work.

reversed.zh: 过度安于现状，或稳定的基础正被打破。
reversed.en: You're too comfortable with the status quo, or a stable foundation is being shaken.

upright.zh: 事业或创作中出现了摩擦与竞争，一次挑战正在考验你的干劲。
upright.en: Friction and competition have surfaced around your career or creative work, testing your drive.

reversed.zh: 冲突正在平息，或你仍困在过去的争执中难以释怀。
reversed.en: A conflict is settling down, or you're still stuck in a past argument.

upright.zh: 努力开始得到回报，事业或创作迎来和谐、分享或众人认可的时刻。
upright.en: Effort is starting to pay off — your career or creative work brings harmony, sharing, or recognition.

reversed.zh: 付出与回报暂时失衡，旧日的经历重新浮上心头。
reversed.en: Giving and receiving are briefly out of balance, or the past resurfaces.

upright.zh: 需要静下心评估事业或创作中的进展，耐心和坚持会带来突破。
upright.en: Take time to assess progress on your career or creative work — patience and persistence will pay off.

reversed.zh: 焦虑或三心二意让事业或创作的进展被拖慢。
reversed.en: Anxiety or indecision is slowing down progress on your career or creative work.

upright.zh: 事业或创作进入快速推进的阶段，专注和效率会带来明显进展。
upright.en: your career or creative work is moving into a fast, focused phase — efficiency brings clear progress.

reversed.zh: 进展被延误，或是过于急躁反而让事业或创作停滞。
reversed.en: Progress is delayed, or rushing has actually stalled your career or creative work.

upright.zh: 你已接近事业或创作的目标，即便疲惫也要保持这份坚韧。
upright.en: You're close to your goal in your career or creative work — stay resilient even if you're tired.

reversed.zh: 长期的压力带来倦怠或不安，需要适度放下戒备、寻求支持。
reversed.en: Sustained pressure has brought fatigue or unease; it's okay to lower your guard and ask for support.

upright.zh: 事业或创作中的努力迎来圆满的结果，但也可能伴随沉重的负担。
upright.en: Effort in your career or creative work reaches a fulfilling result, though it may come with a heavy load.

reversed.zh: 是时候放下不再需要的重担，为事业或创作的新篇章腾出空间。
reversed.en: It's time to set down a burden you no longer need, to make room for a new chapter in your career or creative work.

upright.zh: 一个关于事业或创作的新消息或学习机会正在到来，保持好奇心去探索。
upright.en: News or a chance to learn something about your career or creative work is arriving — stay curious.

reversed.zh: 消息尚未成熟，或你在事业或创作上还需要更多耐心去学习。
reversed.en: The news isn't ready yet, or you need more patience to learn about your career or creative work.

upright.zh: 以充沛的干劲主动出击，在事业或创作上大胆采取行动。
upright.en: Ride your drive and take bold action on your career or creative work.

reversed.zh: 行动过于急躁鲁莽，或是事业或创作上的推进突然停滞。
reversed.en: Action has become reckless, or momentum on your career or creative work has suddenly stalled.

upright.zh: 以成熟、包容的姿态照顾好事业或创作，凭直觉与耐心稳住局面。
upright.en: Care for your career or creative work with maturity and intuition, holding steady with patience.

reversed.zh: 情绪化或过度操心让事业或创作失去平衡，需要照顾好自己。
reversed.en: Emotion or over-worrying has thrown your career or creative work off balance — take care of yourself too.

upright.zh: 以稳健的领导力和丰富的经验，在事业或创作中建立起权威与秩序。
upright.en: Bring steady leadership and hard-won experience to build authority in your career or creative work.

reversed.zh: 权威被滥用，或是在事业或创作上缺乏足够的掌控力。
reversed.en: Authority is being misused, or you lack real control over your career or creative work right now.

upright.zh: 一份全新的情感与关系正蓬勃萌发，全心投入这份初生的心意。
upright.en: A brand new spark of emotion and connection is emerging — throw yourself into this early feelings.

reversed.zh: 这份情感与关系的萌芽被压抑，停滞的热情让你迟迟无法真正开始。
reversed.en: This spark of emotion and connection is being held back, and stalled feelings keeps you from truly starting.

upright.zh: 你正面临一个关于感情或人际的选择或需要找到平衡的伙伴关系。
upright.en: You're facing a choice about a relationship, or need to find balance with a partner.

reversed.en: Anxiety or indecision is slowing down progress on a decision or conversation.

upright.zh: 沟通或决策进入快速推进的阶段，专注和效率会带来明显进展。
upright.en: a decision or conversation is moving into a fast, focused phase — efficiency brings clear progress.

reversed.zh: 进展被延误，或是过于急躁反而让沟通或决策停滞。
reversed.en: Progress is delayed, or rushing has actually stalled a decision or conversation.

upright.zh: 你已接近沟通或决策的目标，即便疲惫也要保持这份坚韧。
upright.en: You're close to your goal in a decision or conversation — stay resilient even if you're tired.

reversed.zh: 长期的压力带来倦怠或不安，需要适度放下戒备、寻求支持。
reversed.en: Sustained pressure has brought fatigue or unease; it's okay to lower your guard and ask for support.

upright.zh: 沟通或决策中的努力迎来圆满的结果，但也可能伴随沉重的负担。
upright.en: Effort in a decision or conversation reaches a fulfilling result, though it may come with a heavy load.

reversed.zh: 是时候放下不再需要的重担，为沟通或决策的新篇章腾出空间。
reversed.en: It's time to set down a burden you no longer need, to make room for a new chapter in a decision or conversation.

upright.zh: 一个关于沟通或决策的新消息或学习机会正在到来，保持好奇心去探索。
upright.en: News or a chance to learn something about a decision or conversation is arriving — stay curious.

reversed.zh: 消息尚未成熟，或你在沟通或决策上还需要更多耐心去学习。
reversed.en: The news isn't ready yet, or you need more patience to learn about a decision or conversation.

upright.zh: 以充沛的思路主动出击，在沟通或决策上大胆采取行动。
upright.en: Ride your thinking and take bold action on a decision or conversation.

reversed.zh: 行动过于急躁鲁莽，或是沟通或决策上的推进突然停滞。
reversed.en: Action has become reckless, or momentum on a decision or conversation has suddenly stalled.

upright.zh: 以成熟、包容的姿态照顾好沟通或决策，凭直觉与耐心稳住局面。
upright.en: Care for a decision or conversation with maturity and intuition, holding steady with patience.

reversed.zh: 情绪化或过度操心让沟通或决策失去平衡，需要照顾好自己。
reversed.en: Emotion or over-worrying has thrown a decision or conversation off balance — take care of yourself too.

upright.zh: 以稳健的领导力和丰富的经验，在沟通或决策中建立起权威与秩序。
upright.en: Bring steady leadership and hard-won experience to build authority in a decision or conversation.

reversed.zh: 权威被滥用，或是在沟通或决策上缺乏足够的掌控力。
reversed.en: Authority is being misused, or you lack real control over a decision or conversation right now.

upright.zh: 一份全新的现实与资源正蓬勃萌发，全心投入这份初生的踏实感。
upright.en: A brand new spark of material life and resources is emerging — throw yourself into this early groundedness.

reversed.zh: 这份现实与资源的萌芽被压抑，停滞的热情让你迟迟无法真正开始。
reversed.en: This spark of material life and resources is being held back, and stalled groundedness keeps you from truly starting.

upright.zh: 你正面临一个关于金钱或健康的选择或需要找到平衡的伙伴关系。
upright.en: You're facing a choice about money or health, or need to find balance with a partner.

reversed.zh: 选择陷入僵局，或金钱或健康中的平衡被打破。
reversed.en: A choice has stalled, or the balance around money or health has been thrown off.

upright.zh: 初步的努力开始显现成果，金钱或健康正稳步向前扩展。
upright.en: Early effort is starting to pay off — money or health is steadily expanding.

reversed.zh: 扩展的计划遇到延迟，团队或计划中出现协作上的落差。
reversed.en: An expanding plan hits a delay, or a team effort loses coordination.

upright.zh: 是时候稳固已有的成果，在金钱或健康中找到一个安稳的立足点。
upright.en: It's time to secure what you've built and find stable footing in money or health.

reversed.zh: 过度安于现状，或稳定的基础正被打破。
reversed.en: You're too comfortable with the status quo, or a stable foundation is being shaken.

upright.zh: 金钱或健康中出现了摩擦与竞争，一次挑战正在考验你的踏实感。
upright.en: Friction and competition have surfaced around money or health, testing your groundedness.

reversed.zh: 冲突正在平息，或你仍困在过去的争执中难以释怀。
reversed.en: A conflict is settling down, or you're still stuck in a past argument.

upright.zh: 努力开始得到回报，金钱或健康迎来和谐、分享或众人认可的时刻。
upright.en: Effort is starting to pay off — money or health brings harmony, sharing, or recognition.

reversed.zh: 付出与回报暂时失衡，旧日的经历重新浮上心头。
reversed.en: Giving and receiving are briefly out of balance, or the past resurfaces.

upright.zh: 需要静下心评估金钱或健康中的进展，耐心和坚持会带来突破。
upright.en: Take time to assess progress on money or health — patience and persistence will pay off.

reversed.zh: 焦虑或三心二意让金钱或健康的进展被拖慢。
